#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build the contest ESP32-S3 board with a temporary, reversible
# esp-hal-3rdparty lock-initializer backport.
#
# Fresh workspaces may not contain esp-hal-3rdparty yet. NuttX prepares it
# during the normal build context phase, so this wrapper bootstraps that
# phase first when needed, then applies the local backport and performs the
# real build.
# ROBOT_VOICE_TRANSPORT_HOOKS_V2: contest-local Agent source tree is authoritative.

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
readonly CONFIG_PATH="vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/configs/nsh"
readonly HAL_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/esp_hal_lock_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_BREAK_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_break_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_WLAN_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/esp32s3_wlan_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_raw_exception_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC="${NUTTX_RAW_EXC:-0}"
readonly AI_AGENT_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ai_agent_esp32s3_backport.sh"  # compatibility-only; never edits Agent source
readonly FFMPEG_AMIX_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ffmpeg_amix_backport.sh"
readonly VOICE_HOOK_HEADER="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_voice_agent_hooks.h"
readonly MYENV_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/myenv"
readonly BUILD_SH="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/build.sh"
readonly NUTTX_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/nuttx"
readonly HAL_DIR="${NUTTX_DIR}/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp-hal-3rdparty"
readonly HAL_CACHE_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/third_party/esp-hal-3rdparty"
readonly HAL_EXPECTED_VERSION="$(
  sed -n \
    's/^[[:space:]]*ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*//p' \
    "${NUTTX_DIR}/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/Make.defs" | head -n 1
)"
readonly HAL_URL="$(
  sed -n \
    's/^[[:space:]]*ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*//p' \
    "${NUTTX_DIR}/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/Make.defs" | head -n 1
)"
readonly -a HAL_REQUIRED_SUBMODULES=(
  components/mbedtls/mbedtls
  components/esp_phy/lib
  components/esp_wifi/lib
  components/bt/controller/lib_esp32c3_family
  components/esp_coex/lib
)
readonly AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent"

readonly VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED="${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED:-0}"
readonly VOICE_TLS_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/infra/vela_tls.c"
readonly VOICE_MIMO_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/voice/mimo_voice.c"
# These are user-owned source trees.  build.sh context is allowed to prepare
# its generated context and HAL checkout, but it must not replace local source
# files before the actual make.  Override this list when the project layout
# uses different source roots.
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS="${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS:-packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src}"
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/openvela-local-source-${BASHPID}"

cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}"

snapshot_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local found=0

  mkdir -p "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  : > "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  for rel in ${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS}; do
    if test ! -d "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}"; then
      echo "Local source snapshot: skip missing ${rel}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    # Snapshot user-owned source/config only.  Never preserve generated
    # objects/archives, otherwise restore_local_sources() can resurrect stale
    # code after a context/clean operation.
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" \
      --exclude=.git \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      -cpf "${archive}" "${rel}"
    printf '%s\n' "${rel}" >> "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"
    found=1
  done

  if test "${found}" != 1; then
    echo "No local source roots were found; refusing to build without source protection." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Local source snapshot created; context may not replace local source files."
}

restore_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local restore_root="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/restore"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"
  mkdir -p "${restore_root}"

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    tar -C "${restore_root}" -xpf "${archive}"
    rsync -a --delete \
      --exclude='.git' \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      --exclude='*.pyc' \
      --exclude='__pycache__/' \
      "${restore_root}/${rel}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}/"
  done < "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"

  echo "Local source snapshot restored; compiling the files present before context."
}

apply_contest_ai_agent_overlay()
{
  if test ! -d "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}"; then
    echo "Missing contest-local ai_agent overlay: ${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # The generated build context still resolves the package from
  # packages/ai_agent.  Synchronize the complete contest-local package there,
  # including deletions, while leaving the nested Git metadata and generated
  # build artifacts alone. restore_local_sources() restores the original
  # checkout at EXIT.
  ai_agent_overlay_applied=1
  rsync -a --delete \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.o' \
    --exclude='*.a' \
    --exclude='*.d' \
    --exclude='*.gcno' \
    --exclude='*.gcda' \
    --exclude='*.pyc' \
    --exclude='__pycache__/' \
    "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/"

  echo "Complete contest-local ai_agent source tree applied; build uses the contest copy."
}

cleanup_local_source_snapshot()
{
  if test -d "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"; then
    rm -rf "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  fi
}

if test ! -x "${MYENV_DIR}/bin/python"; then
  echo "Creating Python virtual environment: ${MYENV_DIR}"
  python3 -m venv "${MYENV_DIR}"
fi

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "${MYENV_DIR}/bin/activate"

# Keep the board-local esptool wrapper ahead of the system PATH.
export PATH="${SCRIPT_DIR}:${PATH}"

hal_tree_ready()
{
  local tree="$1"
  local submodule
  local status_line

  test -n "${HAL_EXPECTED_VERSION}" || return 1
  test -d "${tree}" || return 1
  git -C "${tree}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  test "$(git -C "${tree}" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" = "${HAL_EXPECTED_VERSION}" || return 1

  # A matching top-level commit is insufficient: wireless builds require these
  # submodules to be initialized in the cached checkout as well.
  for submodule in "${HAL_REQUIRED_SUBMODULES[@]}"; do
    status_line="$(git -C "${tree}" submodule status --recursive -- "${submodule}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]][0-9a-f]{40}[[:space:]]' <<<"${status_line}"; then
      return 1
    fi
  done
}

hal_checkout_ready()
{
  hal_tree_ready "${HAL_DIR}"
}

hal_cache_ready()
{
  hal_tree_ready "${HAL_CACHE_DIR}"
}

restore_hal_from_cache()
{
  if ! hal_cache_ready; then
    return 1
  fi

  mkdir -p "$(dirname "${HAL_DIR}")"
  if test -e "${HAL_DIR}" || test -L "${HAL_DIR}"; then
    rm -rf "${HAL_DIR}"
  fi
  rsync -a --delete "${HAL_CACHE_DIR}/" "${HAL_DIR}/"

  if ! hal_checkout_ready; then
    rm -rf "${HAL_DIR}"
    echo "Local HAL cache restore failed commit or submodule validation." >&2
    return 1
  fi

  echo "HAL restored from local cache: ${HAL_CACHE_DIR}"
  echo "HAL HEAD: $(git -C "${HAL_DIR}" rev-parse HEAD)"
}

save_hal_to_cache()
{
  local cache_parent cache_tmp

  if ! hal_checkout_ready; then
    echo "Cannot cache HAL: checkout, commit, or required submodules are invalid." >&2
    return 1
  fi

  cache_parent="$(dirname "${HAL_CACHE_DIR}")"
  cache_tmp="${HAL_CACHE_DIR}.tmp-${BASHPID}"
  mkdir -p "${cache_parent}"
  rm -rf "${cache_tmp}"

text: 根因已确认：ESP32-S3 GDMA 对每个出链描述符产生的是 `OUT_EOF`（现场停止时 `raw=0x2`，对应 EOF），当前 lower-half 却只使能/处理 `OUT_DONE`。因此 DMA 已取到描述符但上层永远收不到完成回调，4 个槽耗尽后播放停在约 1～2 秒。下面只调整 contest 内 `contest_i2s.c` 的完成中断事件，保持槽数量、DMA 内存和网络配置不变。

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/contest_i2s.c
@@
-/* Each immutable descriptor reads a private DMA block allocated only during
- * TTS playback.  Upper APBs can therefore complete at OUT_DONE without
- * being revisited by the circular DMA ring.  Keep the completed private
- * block unchanged for a short FIFO-drain interval before its APB is reused. */
+/* Each immutable descriptor reads a private DMA block allocated only during
+ * TTS playback.  GDMA raises OUT_EOF when the descriptor payload has been
+ * consumed. Keep the completed private block unchanged for a short FIFO-drain
+ * interval before its APB is reused. */
@@
-  /* OUT_DONE is the completion event used by the fixed sequential ring. */
+  /* OUT_EOF is the per-descriptor completion event. OUT_DONE is not emitted
+   * for this cyclic descriptor chain on ESP32-S3. */
   SET_GDMA_CH_BITS(DMA_OUT_INT_ENA_CH0_REG, priv->dma_channel,
-                   DMA_OUT_DONE_CH0_INT_ENA |
+                   DMA_OUT_EOF_CH0_INT_ENA |
                    DMA_OUT_DSCR_ERR_CH0_INT_ENA);
   CLR_GDMA_CH_BITS(DMA_OUT_INT_ENA_CH0_REG, priv->dma_channel,
-                   DMA_OUT_TOTAL_EOF_CH0_INT_ENA);
+                   DMA_OUT_DONE_CH0_INT_ENA |
+                   DMA_OUT_TOTAL_EOF_CH0_INT_ENA);
@@
-         "irq=DONE(sequential) descriptors=frozen\n",
+         "irq=EOF(sequential) descriptors=frozen\n",
@@
-  /* OUT_DONE is sufficient for the fixed sequential ring. */
+  /* OUT_EOF is the per-descriptor completion event for the cyclic ring. */
@@
-  if ((status & (DMA_OUT_DONE_CH0_INT_ST |
+  if ((status & (DMA_OUT_EOF_CH0_INT_ST |
                  DMA_OUT_DSCR_ERR_CH0_INT_ST)) == 0)
@@
-      if ((status & DMA_OUT_DONE_CH0_INT_ST) != 0)
+      if ((status & DMA_OUT_EOF_CH0_INT_ST) != 0)
@@
-               * OUT_DONE means GDMA finished the descriptor, but the I2S FIFO
+               * OUT_EOF means GDMA finished the descriptor, but the I2S FIFO
@@
-       * Normal OUT_DONE callbacks are immediate.  Keeping the old 8 ms delay
+       * Normal OUT_EOF callbacks are immediate.  Keeping the old 8 ms delay
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

日志中：

- PCM 实际只入队 `77824` 字节，按 24 kHz、单声道、16 bit 计算约为 `1.62 秒`。
- I2S DMA 状态为 `raw=0x2`，对应 ESP32-S3 的 `DMA_OUT_EOF_CH0_INT`。
- 原驱动只监听 `OUT_DONE`，因此 DMA 已消耗数据，但上层没有收到完成回调，播放队列最终阻塞并触发 xrun。

已修改：

- [contest_i2s.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/contest_i2s.c:1680)：使用 `OUT_EOF` 作为每个 DMA 描述符的完成事件。

- 同步修正了终止音频块和 DMA 环形队列处理，避免播放结束时重新循环旧数据。

这次日志确认是上一次 DMA 修复引入的启动死锁：

- 日志只有 `DMA ready slots=4`，没有出现 `tx GDMA-IMMUTABLE start`。
- 第一个 PCM 块已经入队，但 `dma_done=0、played=0`。
- 驱动要求先填满 4 个槽才启动 DMA，而媒体层是提交一块、等待回调后再提交下一块，因此永远无法启动。

已修改 [contest_i2s.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/contest_i2s.c:1578)：

- 首个 PCM 块到达时，将其余槽预置为静音 DMA 描述符；
- 立即启动 4 槽 DMA 环；
- 后续 PCM 块复用这些槽位，不再等待所有槽都先有真实音频；
- 保留 `OUT_EOF` 完成中断处理。

snapshot_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local found=0

  mkdir -p "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  : > "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  for rel in ${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS}; do
    if test ! -d "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}"; then
      echo "Local source snapshot: skip missing ${rel}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    # Snapshot user-owned source/config only.  Never preserve generated
    # objects/archives, otherwise restore_local_sources() can resurrect stale
    # code after a context/clean operation.
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" \
      --exclude=.git \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      -cpf "${archive}" "${rel}"
    printf '%s\n' "${rel}" >> "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"
    found=1
  done

  if test "${found}" != 1; then
    echo "No local source roots were found; refusing to build without source protection." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Local source snapshot created; context may not replace local source files."
}

restore_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local restore_root="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/restore"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"
  mkdir -p "${restore_root}"

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    tar -C "${restore_root}" -xpf "${archive}"
    rsync -a --delete \
      --exclude='.git' \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      --exclude='*.pyc' \
      --exclude='__pycache__/' \
      "${restore_root}/${rel}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}/"
  done < "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"

  echo "Local source snapshot restored; compiling the files present before context."
}

  ai_agent_overlay_applied=1

  echo "Complete contest-local ai_agent source tree applied; build uses the contest copy."
}

description: Create, update, review, or audit NuttX RTOS C device drivers. Use for driver implementation, code audit, sensor/timer/LED/ethernet/CAN/LIN/fb/LCD/audio/PA/battery subsystems, or board bringup.
---

# NuttX Driver Development

Follow the full driver lifecycle in order. Keep edits small and testable.

> [!TIP] This skill can be used standalone or via the `driver-workflow` agent (`agents/driver-workflow.agent.md`) for end-to-end driver development with automated reference matching, requirements generation, and PR submission.

## Table of Contents

1. [Preparation](#preparation)
   - Clarify scope and expectations
   - Find reference drivers
   - Determine driver pattern
   - Layout driver files
2. [Implementation](#implementation)
   - Write driver C implementation
   - Write public header file
   - Kconfig and build system integration
   - Board-level registration
3. [NuttX Coding & Kernel API Rules](#nuttx-coding--kernel-api-rules)
4. [Code Review](#code-review)
5. [References](#references)

---

## Preparation

### 1) Clarify scope and expectations

- Identify the NuttX driver subsystem (sensor, serial, timer, analog, etc.).
- Confirm target bus (I2C, SPI, 1-Wire, etc.) and required hardware properties.
- Clarify the NuttX source tree location. The driver code lives under `nuttx/drivers/`.

### 2) Find reference drivers

> [!NOTE] Two types of reference drivers serve different purposes
>
> - **骨架参考（NuttX API 模式）**: 优先使用 NuttX in-tree 同类驱动作为代码骨架，确保符合 NuttX 的 upper-half/lower-half 架构和 VFS 集成方式
> - **芯片参考（寄存器/时序验证）**: 优先使用 Linux/Zephyr 同芯片驱动，用于交叉验证 datasheet 的寄存器定义、初始化序列、SPI 帧格式等芯片专属知识
>
> When used standalone: 手动搜索两类参考驱动
> When used with `driver-workflow` agent: Step A.2 自动完成两条线的并行搜索

Always look at the in-tree NuttX drivers before doing any work. There might already be a driver that (best scenario at the top):

1. Is exactly the same part as the one you are working on
2. Targets a very similar part from the same vendor (e.g., BMP280 vs BME680)
3. Is the same device subsystem as yours (e.g., another I2C sensor)

If a reference driver is found, use it as a **skeleton template**:

1. Copy the source file structure (function signatures, bus access pattern, registration flow, file layout)
2. Replace all device-specific content: register definitions, chip ID values, vendor/chip names, init sequences, calibration logic
3. After generating code, grep for the original chip name — zero matches required
4. **Do NOT copy register addresses or chip-specific constants** — these must come from the target device's datasheet

Re-use these files/folders whenever possible:
- Header files in `include/nuttx/sensors/`, `include/nuttx/i2c/`, etc.
- Existing board-level registration patterns in `boards/`

If no suitable reference driver exists:

1. Use the dispatch table below to load the subsystem-specific pattern reference
2. Use the most similar subsystem's reference driver as template (e.g., use accelerometer driver as template for gyro)
3. Follow the architectural pattern (uORB vs chardev) strictly from the loaded reference
4. For 🔲 Planned subsystems, use `chardev_pattern.md` (Production-Quality Skeleton section) as the starting point

Here are the relevant folders to search for examples:

```
nuttx/
├── drivers/          # Device-specific driver sources. Search here first
│   ├── sensors/      # Sensor drivers (I2C/SPI/1-Wire)
│   ├── serial/       # UART/serial drivers
│   ├── i2c/          # I2C bus framework
│   ├── spi/          # SPI bus framework
│   ├── timers/       # Timer/watchdog/RTC drivers
│   ├── analog/       # ADC/DAC drivers
│   ├── leds/         # LED drivers
│   ├── input/        # Input device drivers
│   └── ...           # Many more subsystems
├── include/nuttx/    # Public header files for driver APIs
│   ├── sensors/      # Sensor driver headers & sensor_lowerhalf_s
│   ├── i2c/          # I2C master interface (i2c_master_s)
│   ├── spi/          # SPI interface (spi_dev_s)
│   └── fs/           # VFS file_operations, register_driver()
├── boards/           # Board-specific initialization & driver registration
└── arch/             # Architecture-specific lower-half bus implementations
```

Use `references/nuttx_nav_search.md` for driver examples and navigating the NuttX repo.

### 3) Determine Driver Pattern

NuttX uses a **POSIX VFS-based** driver model. Every device appears as a file under `/dev/`. Choose the appropriate pattern based on driver subsystem type:

#### Driver Type Dispatch Table

Based on the identified subsystem, load the corresponding reference document for subsystem-specific implementation details:

| Subsystem | Pattern | Reference Document | Status |
|-----------|---------|-------------------|--------|
| **sensors** (accel, gyro, baro, temp, humi, light, mag, prox, IMU...) | Upper-Half / Lower-Half (uORB) | `references/sensor_uorb_pattern.md` | ✅ Available |
| **gnss** (GPS, GNSS, satellite positioning) | Upper-Half / Lower-Half (gnss_uorb) | `references/gnss_uorb_pattern.md` | ✅ Available |
| **net** (Ethernet, SPI-Ethernet) | Upper-Half / Lower-Half (netdev) | `references/eth_netdev_pattern.md` | ✅ Available |

> [!IMPORTANT] How to use this dispatch table
>
> 1. Identify the driver subsystem from the user's request
> 2. If the subsystem has an **✅ Available** reference → load that reference document for subsystem-specific architecture, data structures, callbacks, and registration API
>    - **Special case: USB subsystem** → The USB DCD driver is located in `nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/`, not in `nuttx/drivers/`. The documentation loading rules are as follows:
>      - **Must be loaded** `references/usbdev_dcd_pattern.md` — The core reference for all USB DCD adapters (usbdev interface, EP0 state machine, DMA alignment, debug methods)
>      - **Must be loaded (vendor HAL adaptation)** `references/usb_bes_v2_lessons.md` — When adapting a USB DCD driver on top of a vendor HAL layer (not writing bare-metal register code), load this document for common pitfalls: HAL re-init after bus reset, speed detection, VBUS call chain tracing, callback context design, and incremental build traps. These lessons apply to all vendor HAL-based USB DCD work, not only BES.
>      - **Load on demand** `references/usb_source_lookup.md` — Load when you need to find the reference driver source code or when you are unsure of the controller IP type (Phase 1 research phase).
>      - **Load on demand** `references/usb_dwc3_case_study.md` — Load when the target controller is DWC3 or CDNS3 (TRB architecture); other IPs can be skipped, but it is recommended to browse the Bug Pattern Summary table to understand common bug patterns.
>    - **Special case: MCAL subsystem** → The MCAL adaptation layer bridges AUTOSAR MCAL modules to NuttX upper-half drivers. It is located in `frameworks/system/autocore/mcal/`, not in `nuttx/drivers/`. The documentation loading rules are as follows:
>      - **Must be loaded** `references/mcal_autosar_pattern.md` — The core reference for all MCAL adaptations (9-step workflow, architecture, code generation rules, EB Tresos config, build verification)
>      - **Must be loaded** `references/mcal_code_pattern.md` — C code templates for adaptation files (struct layout, ops callbacks, init function, ISR routing, notification callbacks, Det/Dem error reporting)
>      - **Must be loaded** `references/mcal_module_mapping.md` — MCAL→NuttX framework mapping table, cross-module dependency list with EB config steps, NuttX ops structures, MCAL API patterns, search paths
> 3. If the subsystem is **🔲 Planned** → fall back to Pattern B (standalone character device) below, and search in-tree drivers under `nuttx/drivers/<subsystem>/` for reference implementations
> 4. The reference document contains ALL subsystem-specific knowledge (data structures, callback details, registration API, data delivery modes, etc.). The main SKILL.md only contains cross-subsystem generic knowledge.

> [!NOTE] Adding a new driver subsystem reference
>
> To add support for a new driver subsystem (e.g., timers, leds, input):
> 1. Create `references/<subsystem>_pattern.md` following the structure of `sensor_uorb_pattern.md`
> 2. Include: architecture overview, key data structures, callback table, data delivery modes, registration API, complete examples
> 3. Update the Driver Type Dispatch Table above to change status from 🔲 to ✅
> 4. Add example driver paths to `references/nuttx_nav_search.md` under the corresponding subsystem section
> 5. The main SKILL.md does NOT need other modifications — the dispatch mechanism handles routing automatically

#### Pattern A: Upper-Half / Lower-Half — Preferred for Subsystem Drivers

Most NuttX driver subsystems (sensors, timers, serial, audio, etc.) use an upper-half/lower-half split. The upper-half provides the VFS interface and common logic; you only implement the lower-half callbacks.

```
Application
    │  open/read/write/ioctl/poll
    ▼
  VFS (/dev/...)
    │
    ▼
  Upper-half (provided by NuttX)  ← Generic, handles VFS + common logic
    │  subsystem-specific callbacks
    ▼
  Lower-half (your driver)  ← You implement these
    │
    ▼
  Bus API (I2C_TRANSFER / SPI_*)
```

**When to use**: Always prefer this when the subsystem provides an upper-half framework. Load the corresponding reference document from the dispatch table for implementation details.

#### Pattern B: Standalone Character Device Driver

The simplest pattern. The driver directly implements `struct file_operations` and registers with `register_driver()`.

```
Application
    │  open/read/write/ioctl/close
    ▼
  VFS (/dev/mydevN)
    │
    ▼
  file_operations  ← Your driver implements these
    │
    ▼
  Bus API (I2C_TRANSFER / SPI_LOCK+SPI_SELECT+SPI_RECVBLOCK)
```

**When to use**: Only when the device doesn't fit any existing subsystem, or when existing in-tree drivers for the same device class already use this pattern (e.g., some vibrator or custom peripheral drivers).

See `references/chardev_pattern.md` for standalone character device implementation details.

### 4) Layout the driver files

Define the files that will be created/modified. The exact layout depends on the subsystem — refer to the loaded reference document for subsystem-specific examples.

General layout:

```
nuttx/
├── drivers/<subsystem>/
│   ├── mydevice.c            # Driver implementation
│   ├── Make.defs             # Add CSRCS += mydevice.c
│   ├── CMakeLists.txt        # Add list(APPEND SRCS mydevice.c)
│   └── Kconfig               # Add CONFIG_<SUBSYSTEM>_MYDEVICE entry
├── include/nuttx/<subsystem>/
│   └── mydevice.h            # Public header: register function prototype
└── boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/src/
    └── <board>_mydevice.c    # Board-level init: get bus, call register
```

## Implementation

> [!info] TLDR
>
> - Implement C driver (lower-half callbacks OR file_operations)
> - Create public header file with register function prototype
> - Add Kconfig entry for driver enable/disable
> - Add source to Make.defs and CMakeLists.txt
> - Write board-level registration code

### Write the Driver C Implementation

For subsystem-specific implementation (sensor uORB, timer, LED, etc.), load the corresponding reference document from the Driver Type Dispatch Table above.

The following sections cover **cross-subsystem generic patterns** that apply to all driver types.

#### Bus Access (I2C / SPI)

For I2C/SPI register read/write helpers, bulk transfer patterns, SPI frame protocols (8-bit and 16-bit), and SPI mode detection — read `references/bus_access.md` when writing bus access code.

### Write the Public Header File

Create `include/nuttx/<subsystem>/mydevice.h`. The header content depends on the driver pattern:

- **Upper-half/lower-half drivers**: Header contains only the register function prototype
- **Standalone char device drivers**: Header also defines data structures for `read()`

已修复当前音乐播放立即停止的问题，并完成构建。

日志中的直接链路是：

- `PCM dequeue ... played=0`
- `native Media PCM underflow`
- `no PCM input for 12000 ms`
- I2S `tx timeout`
- `rc=-125` 是超时后的取消结果

因此音乐停止的主因是 I2S DMA 没有继续推进，不是歌曲下载失败。并发出现的 `tcp-timed-connect` 属于语音网络请求，和已经开始的音乐播放是两个独立问题。

本次修改：

- 在每次新的 I2S 播放会话启动前复位 TX FIFO，清除上一次取消播放留下的 FIFO 状态：[contest_i2s.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/contest_i2s.c:2172)
- 保留 ESP32-S3 的 `OUT_EOF` DMA 完成路径和不可变描述符环。
- 保留空闲 DMA 槽预填充静音，避免首个 PCM 到来前环无法启动。
- 增加低频诊断日志，确认 worker、首次 DMA 提交和 DMA 启动状态：[robot_audio_playback.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_audio_playback.c:739)
- 音频 APB 仍在复制到私有 PCM 环后及时归还，避免 Media 缓冲池耗尽。

# TF5 网络恢复与退出对话修复

## 日志能确认什么

粘贴的日志中，`associated=1` 且有 IPv4，但 TCP 连接收到 `poll=0x8`、
`so_error=0`。旧实现会在没有 POLLOUT 时自行返回 `-ECONNABORTED`，所以这里的
`rc=-103` 不能直接证明 Wi-Fi 已断开。新实现为这条路径增加一次新 socket 的连接兼容回退，
不会把未确认的连接当成已连接。

另一个附件日志中，`associated=0`、`ipv4=0.0.0.0`，表明该时刻确实未关联且没有有效地址。
旧程序只重建 TCP/TLS，诊断发现掉线后也没有重新入网，因此持续 ASR 重试无法修复链路。

检查 TF5 的回复完成路径，没有发现按“回复结束”主动关闭 Wi-Fi 的代码。TLS socket 的关闭
与无线网络断开是不同操作。现有日志仍不足以确定无线链路丢失本身是热点、射频、电源还是驱动原因。

## 修改后的行为

- 语音监听运行时，每秒检查关联和 IPv4；待唤醒状态也继续检查，无需再说一句话才能触发恢复。
- 仍关联但没有地址时先尝试 DHCP；失去关联或 DHCP 修复失败时，使用已保存的 SSID/密码重新入网。
- 连续连接建立失败达到三次时，允许做一次受控重新入网；对这种“仍关联”的修复设置至少三十秒的间隔，
  避免服务端不可达时频繁重置 Wi-Fi。HTTP 错误响应、单次慢 TTS、解析失败不会直接重置链路。
- 重新入网失败后按三、六、十二、二十四、三十秒退避，之后最多每三十秒再试。恢复使用已保存的凭据，
  不反复写入配置；没有保存凭据时输出 `missing-saved-credentials`。
- 自动恢复必须取得 HTTP 独占许可：已有请求先完成，新请求在原超时预算内等待；恢复后旧 TLS 连接失效，
  各任务组只清理自己拥有的描述符。
- 新增 `退出语音对话`、`结束语音对话`、`退出语音模式` 等完整指令，以及“请”“请你”“吧”等有限礼貌变体。
  `不要退出语音对话`、`如何退出语音对话` 等句子不会被误当作退出命令。
- 完整 ASR 最终文本匹配退出命令后，立即由本地状态机处理：取消旧回复、清理旧任务、返回等待 TFLite 唤醒，
  播放现有 `chat_exit.wav`。即使提示音提交失败，也已经退出对话。
- 重置退出时的识别序号，防止旧结果迟到后阻塞下一次唤醒后的问题。原有无输入超时退出也复用这条状态转换。

退出指令仍依赖在线 ASR 成功返回最终文本。完全断网时没有新增本地“退出”语音识别模型；
停止说话后，现有无输入超时仍会退回待唤醒。DHCP 为平台阻塞 API，恢复等待受平台自身超时影响；
期间采集和声学唤醒线程仍独立运行，控制线程在本次恢复调用返回后继续处理结果。

## 安装与构建

将压缩包的 `robot_voice/` 覆盖到工程 `contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/` 下，保留已导入的模型文件。
不要形成 `robot_voice/robot_voice/` 嵌套。然后从工程根目录运行包装入口：

```bash
cd ~/vela/openvela
python3 contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/scripts/build_voice.py \\
  --openvela . -- -j8
```

该入口会先注册语音应用、修复 Agent Make 链接源清单并同步必要配置，再调用原板级脚本。
直接调用板级脚本会绕过这些步骤。

包中保留原模型数据、TFLM 推理实现及本地 WAV 的原始字节；无需重新导入模型。
旧目标文件、Make.dep 和 Python 缓存没有放入本次源代码包。
`TF5_NETWORK_RECOVERY.patch` 提供相对本次上传版的完整文本修改。

## 验证

主机回归已覆盖退出命令、反例、忙状态退出、旧 ASR/Agent 回复丢弃、再次唤醒，
Wi-Fi 丢关联、地址丢失、DHCP、失败退避、没有凭据、并发恢复互斥、持续 POLLERR 兼容回退、
连接池失效、请求等待与超时、POST 不重复发送，并检查了现有语音采集/ASR/TTS/播放用例。

Wi-Fi 和 mbedTLS 接口使用测试替身，TCP 使用本机回环连接；没有执行完整 ESP32-S3 固件构建，
也没有在真实热点上验证无线驱动。相关测试命令：

```bash
python3 tests/run_tests.py
python3 tests/test_transport_recovery.py
python3 tests/test_network_recovery_integration.py
python3 tests/test_tls_retry.py
python3 tests/test_http_deadlines.py
python3 tests/test_archive_build.py
```

板上建议依次验证：连续问答；说“退出语音对话”并确认日志进入等待唤醒；再次唤醒后提问；
关闭再恢复热点，观察 `[网络恢复] begin`、`connected` 日志和后续问答。

从日志看，设备“连接在热点上”只能证明 WLAN 已关联并拿到 IPv4，不能证明 TCP/HTTPS 仍然可用。

关键证据：

- `link+IPv4=1 ip=192.168.43.213`
- `WLAN-RX ... free_min=21 ... nobuf=0 work_fail=0`：RX 缓冲没有耗尽。
- LLM 请求先成功，随后 TTS 在 `tls-handshake` 阶段超时。
- `sent=0`、`bio_reads=0`、`poll_timeouts=47`、`errno=11`：请求尚未发送到 HTTP 层，TLS socket 一直处于 `EAGAIN`，说明 TCP/WLAN 数据路径卡住或对端握手无响应。

当前恢复代码还有一个缺口：只把 `dns`、`tcp-*`、`tls-write` 计入网络故障，日志实际失败的是 `tls-handshake`，所以连续失败不会触发 Wi-Fi 重连。

我已修复：

[robot_voice_http.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_voice_http.c:1059)

现在连续 3 次 TLS 建连类超时会进入已有的 Wi-Fi 恢复流程：

```text
[网络恢复] attempt reason=persistent-tcp-failure
[网络恢复] connected
```

恢复仍按每秒检查、失败退避和 HTTP 独占保护执行，不会因为一次临时 TTS 超时就立即重置热点。

已重新构建成功：

```text
/home/foam/vela/openvela/nuttx/nuttx.bin
SHA256:
5eff5794ecd43e7be10101eff996ccdc5a5ecc1edc8a9b5d55407c2db9bd5a6f
```

`git diff --check` 通过。尚未在真实手机热点上烧录验证。烧录后重点观察是否出现 `[网络恢复] attempt` 和后续 `[网络恢复] connected`；如果恢复后仍失败，再需要同时提供 `netstat -an`、`network_wifi_diag` 和新的 `RV-TCP/RV-NET-ERROR` 日志，以区分热点路由问题和 NuttX TCP/WLAN 状态卡死。

static void *contest_media_pace_worker(FAR void *arg)
{
  FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *sink = arg;

  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] DMA completion worker queue=%u\n",
         CONTEST_MEDIA_PACE_QUEUE);

  for (;;)
    {
      struct contest_media_pending_s entry;

      int wait_ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(
        &sink->pace_data, MSEC2TICK(CONTEST_MEDIA_HEALTH_POLL_MS));
      if (wait_ret == -ETIMEDOUT || wait_ret == -ETIME)
        {
          contest_media_check_health(sink);
          continue;
        }
      if (wait_ret < 0)
        {
          continue;
        }

      while (contest_media_pop_apb(sink, &entry))
        {
          bool aborted = contest_media_pace_aborted(sink);
          bool dma_done = false;
          uint64_t played = 0;
          uint64_t pending = 0;

          int ret = aborted ? -ECANCELED : sink->stream_error;

          /* robot_audio_playback_write() copies every source byte into the
           * private PCM ring.  Once copied, Media no longer owns or needs
           * this APB; holding it until the samples reach the speaker pins
           * starves abufsrc's six-buffer pool and causes xrun on network
           * streams.  Only FINAL has to wait for acoustic DMA completion. */
          if (ret == OK && entry.final)
            {
              ret = contest_media_wait_dma(sink, entry.endpoint);
            }

          /* Report actual backend progress. Ordinary APBs are deliberately
           * returned after copying into the private ring, so ret==OK alone
           * does not mean that their samples have reached DMA. */
          if (contest_media_progress(sink, &played, &pending, NULL) == OK)
            {
              dma_done = played >= entry.endpoint;
            }

          /* STOP can arrive while waiting. Do not turn that cancellation
           * into natural EOS or finish()/drain the queued music. */
          aborted = contest_media_pace_aborted(sink);
          if (ret < 0 && !aborted)
            {
              sink->stream_error = ret;
            }

          contest_media_dequeue(sink, entry.apb,
                                ret < 0 ? (uint16_t)-ret : OK);
          sink->dequeue_count++;

          if (sink->dequeue_count <= 4 ||
              (sink->dequeue_count % 32) == 0 ||
              entry.final)
            {
              syslog(LOG_INFO,
                     "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] PCM dequeue #%u bytes=%zu "
                     "dma_done=%d final=%d played=%zu copied=%zu\n",
                     sink->dequeue_count, entry.bytes,
                     dma_done ? 1 : 0, entry.final ? 1 : 0,
                     (size_t)played, sink->total_pcm);
            }

          if (entry.final && !aborted && ret == OK)
            {
              int ret;

              /* FINAL's actual samples have completed DMA. Finish joins
               * the backend worker and closes before announcing COMPLETE. */
              ret = contest_media_finish_playback(sink, true);
              if (ret < 0) sink->stream_error = ret;
              contest_media_complete(sink);

              if (ret < 0)
                {
                  syslog(LOG_ERR,
                         "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] final drain failed=%d\n", ret);
                }
            }

          /* Mark the APB idle only after its callback and any FINAL handling
           * have finished.  STOP waits for this flag as well as an empty
           * queue, otherwise it can race the current DMA wait operation. */
          if (nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&sink->pace_lock) == OK)
            {
              bool failed = sink->stream_error < 0 && !sink->pace_abort &&
                            sink->pace_count == 0;
              sink->pace_busy = false;
              nxsem_post(&sink->pace_empty);
              nxsem_post(&sink->pace_lock);
              if (failed)
                {
                  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] DMA failed rc=%d\n",
                         sink->stream_error);
                  (void)contest_media_finish_playback(sink, false);
                  contest_media_complete(sink);
                }
            }
        }
    }

  return NULL;
}

static int contest_media_queue_apb(FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *sink,
                                   FAR struct ap_buffer_s *apb,
                                   size_t bytes, bool final)
{
  int ret;

  ret = nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&sink->pace_lock);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      return ret;
    }

  if (sink->pace_count >= CONTEST_MEDIA_PACE_QUEUE)
    {
      nxsem_post(&sink->pace_lock);
      syslog(LOG_ERR,
             "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] pacer queue full count=%u\n",
             sink->pace_count);
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  sink->pending[sink->pace_tail].apb = apb;
  sink->pending[sink->pace_tail].bytes = bytes;
  sink->pending[sink->pace_tail].endpoint = sink->total_pcm;
  sink->pending[sink->pace_tail].final = final;
  sink->pace_tail = (sink->pace_tail + 1) % CONTEST_MEDIA_PACE_QUEUE;
  sink->pace_count++;

  nxsem_post(&sink->pace_lock);
  nxsem_post(&sink->pace_data);
  return OK;
}

static int contest_media_abort_pending(FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *sink)
{
  int ret;

  ret = nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&sink->pace_lock);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      return ret;
    }

  sink->pace_abort = true;
  nxsem_post(&sink->pace_lock);
  nxsem_post(&sink->pace_data);

  for (;;)
    {
      unsigned int count;
      bool busy;

      ret = nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&sink->pace_lock);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          return ret;
        }

      count = sink->pace_count;
      busy = sink->pace_busy;
      nxsem_post(&sink->pace_lock);

      if (count == 0 && !busy)
        {
          break;
        }

      ret = nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&sink->pace_empty);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          return ret;
        }
    }

  ret = nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&sink->pace_lock);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      return ret;
    }

  sink->pace_abort = false;
  nxsem_post(&sink->pace_lock);
  return OK;
}

static int contest_media_pacer_initialize(FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *sink)
{
  pthread_attr_t attr;
  int ret;

  ret = nxsem_init(&sink->pace_lock, 0, 1);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      return ret;
    }

  ret = nxsem_init(&sink->pace_data, 0, 0);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_lock);
      return ret;
    }

  ret = nxsem_init(&sink->pace_empty, 0, 0);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_data);
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_lock);
      return ret;
    }

  ret = nxsem_init(&sink->playback_lock, 0, 1);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_empty);
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_data);
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_lock);
      return ret;
    }

  ret = nxsem_init(&sink->enqueue_lock, 0, 1);
  ret = nxsem_init(&sink->enqueue_lock, 0, 1);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->playback_lock);
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_empty);
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_data);
      nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_lock);
      return ret;
    }

  ret = pthread_attr_init(&attr);
  if (ret != 0)
    {
      ret = -ret;
      goto fail_sems;
    }

  ret = pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, CONTEST_MEDIA_PACE_STACK);
  if (ret != 0)
    {
      pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
      ret = -ret;
      goto fail_sems;
    }

  ret = pthread_create(&sink->pace_worker, &attr,
                       contest_media_pace_worker, sink);
  pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
  if (ret != 0)
    {
      ret = -ret;
      goto fail_sems;
    }

  sink->pace_worker_started = true;
  return OK;

fail_sems:
  nxsem_destroy(&sink->enqueue_lock);
  nxsem_destroy(&sink->playback_lock);
  nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_empty);
  nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_data);
  nxsem_destroy(&sink->pace_lock);
  return ret;
}

static int contest_media_getcaps(FAR struct audio_lowerhalf_s *dev, int type,
                                 FAR struct audio_caps_s *caps)
{
  (void)dev;
  (void)type;

  if (caps == NULL || caps->ac_len < sizeof(struct audio_caps_s))
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  caps->ac_format.hw = 0;
  caps->ac_controls.w = 0;

  switch (caps->ac_type)
    {
      case AUDIO_TYPE_QUERY:
        if (caps->ac_subtype == AUDIO_TYPE_QUERY)
          {
            /* Overall device capability: playback + PCM. */
            caps->ac_controls.b[0] = AUDIO_TYPE_OUTPUT;
            caps->ac_format.hw = 1 << (AUDIO_FMT_PCM - 1);
          }
        else if (caps->ac_subtype == AUDIO_FMT_PCM)
          {
            /* FFmpeg's NuttX outdev performs a second capability query for
             * PCM subformats.  Report the exact format accepted by the
             * proven robot_audio_playback producer interface. */
            caps->ac_controls.b[0] = AUDIO_SUBFMT_PCM_S16_LE;
            caps->ac_controls.b[1] = AUDIO_SUBFMT_END;
            caps->ac_format.hw = 1 << (AUDIO_FMT_PCM - 1);
          }
        else
          {
            caps->ac_controls.b[0] = AUDIO_SUBFMT_END;
          }
        break;

      case AUDIO_TYPE_OUTPUT:
        if (caps->ac_subtype == AUDIO_TYPE_QUERY)
          {
            /* Advertise exactly the format accepted by the bridge. */
            caps->ac_controls.hw[0] = AUDIO_SAMP_RATE_24K;
            caps->ac_channels = CONTEST_MEDIA_CHANNELS;
            caps->ac_format.hw = 1 << (AUDIO_FMT_PCM - 1);
          }
        break;

      default:
        break;
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] getcaps type=%u subtype=%u fmt=0x%x ch=%u ctl=0x%lx\n",
         caps->ac_type, caps->ac_subtype, caps->ac_format.hw,
         caps->ac_channels, (unsigned long)caps->ac_controls.w);
  return caps->ac_len;
}

#ifdef CONFIG_AUDIO_MULTI_SESSION
static int contest_media_configure(FAR struct audio_lowerhalf_s *dev,
                                   FAR void *session,
                                   FAR const struct audio_caps_s *caps)
#else
static int contest_media_configure(FAR struct audio_lowerhalf_s *dev,
                                   FAR const struct audio_caps_s *caps)
#endif
{
  FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *sink =
    (FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *)dev;
  uint32_t sample_rate;
  uint8_t channels;
  uint8_t bits;

#ifdef CONFIG_AUDIO_MULTI_SESSION
  (void)session;
#endif

  if (caps == NULL)
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  /* Volume/feature control is currently handled by the proven playback
   * path's fixed gain.  Accept feature configure so Media parameter setup
   * cannot tear down an otherwise valid PCM session. */
  if (caps->ac_type == AUDIO_TYPE_FEATURE ||
      caps->ac_type == AUDIO_TYPE_PROCESSING)
    {
      return OK;
    }

  if (caps->ac_type != AUDIO_TYPE_OUTPUT)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] configure unsupported type=%u\n",
             caps->ac_type);
      return -ENOTSUP;
    }

  sample_rate = caps->ac_controls.hw[0] |
                ((uint32_t)caps->ac_controls.b[3] << 16);
  channels = caps->ac_channels;
  bits = caps->ac_controls.b[2];

  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] configure fmt=%u rate=%lu ch=%u bits=%u\n",
         caps->ac_subtype, (unsigned long)sample_rate, channels, bits);

  if (sample_rate != CONTEST_MEDIA_RATE ||
      channels != CONTEST_MEDIA_CHANNELS ||
      bits != CONTEST_MEDIA_BITS)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR,
             "[MEDIA-BRIDGE] format rejected expected=%uHz/%uch/%ubit\n",
             CONTEST_MEDIA_RATE, CONTEST_MEDIA_CHANNELS, CONTEST_MEDIA_BITS);
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  sink->sample_rate = sample_rate;
  sink->channels = channels;
  sink->bits = bits;
  sink->configured = true;
  /* New configuration is a new stream, even after the preceding FINAL. */
  if (!sink->playback_open)
    {
      __atomic_store_n(&sink->completion_sent, false, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
      sink->eos = false;
      sink->stream_error = OK;
    }
  return OK;
}

static int contest_media_shutdown(FAR struct audio_lowerhalf_s *dev)
{
  FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *sink =
    (FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *)dev;
  int ret;

  (void)contest_media_abort_pending(sink);
  ret = contest_media_finish_playback(sink, false);

  sink->configured = false;
  return ret;
}

                               FAR void *session)

  FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *sink =
    (FAR struct contest_media_sink_s *)dev;

  return ret;
}

结论：这次短促声音的主因不是网络，也不是“监听模式”主动停止音乐，而是 I2S DMA 完成中断没有推进播放进度。

日志证据：

- 第一个 PCM 块入队后立即出现 `xrun`。
- `PCM dequeue` 多次显示 `dma_done=0 played=0`。
- DMA 提交成功后仍出现 `native Media PCM underflow`。
- 日志没有 `STOP`、`CLOSE`、`IOERR` 或 `Force close`。

因此，Media 数据已经送到播放层，但底层没有报告 DMA 完成，播放环很快被判定为空。

我已在 contest 工程修复 DMA 完成路径：

- 启用并处理 ESP32-S3 GDMA 的 `DMA_OUT_DONE` 中断；
- 清除并禁用不适用的 `DMA_OUT_EOF`/`TOTAL_EOF` 路径；
- 保持现有 4 个 DMA slot 和内存配置，不增加 WLAN、I2S 或 PSRAM 内存。

相关代码：

- [contest_i2s.c:1748](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/contest_i2s.c:1748)
- [contest_i2s.c:2346](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/contest_i2s.c:2346)
- [robot_audio_playback.c:1754](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_audio_playback.c:1754)

监听状态确实是当前逻辑中的并行行为：Agent 回复确认后，`rv_reply_done_for_run()` 会立即把状态从 `BUSY` 切到 `LISTEN`，见 [robot_voice_main.c:1413](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_voice_main.c:1413)。但这不会直接停止音乐；只有后续真正进入新的语音回复流程时，才会调用 `robot_music_media_stop_for_voice()`。本次日志中的音乐已经在进入监听前发生 DMA/xrun 异常。

构建验证已通过：

- 生成物：`/home/foam/vela/openvela/nuttx/nuttx.bin`
- 大小：`2936468` bytes
- SHA256：`ff833615226c8207a1c977400f682028df179f83bdf058a3f707086745ff0f55`
- `bash -n`：通过
- `git diff --check`：通过
- 音乐构建策略测试、Media 生命周期测试：通过
- native media bridge 主机测试未运行，测试脚本硬编码了不存在的旧路径 `app/src/board_voice_audio.c`

刷入新固件后，播放音乐时应观察：

- `played` 持续增长；
- `[C-I2S] ... done_irq=` 持续增加；
- 不再连续出现 `xrun`；
- 不再出现 `native Media PCM underflow`。

如果仍然只能播放很短声音，请提供完整的 `[C-I2S] tx timeout`、`[C-I2S] ... stop ... done_irq=` 和后续 `MEDIA-BRIDGE` 日志。监听状态若要改成“音乐完成后才进入监听”，需要再把 `RV_MON_LISTEN` 的切换延迟到 `MEDIA_EVENT_COMPLETED`，这是独立于本次 DMA 修复的状态机调整。

已修复媒体启动时序问题，并完成构建。

日志中的根因是：`board_voice_audio.c` 在收到第一块 4096 字节 PCM 时就启动 I2S。此时播放器只有约 85 ms 缓冲，立即出现：

```text
native Media PCM underflow
no PCM input for 12000 ms
playback backend failed
```

随后 `-125` 是关闭时取消 DMA 的结果，不是最初原因。`[语音] 正处于监听模式` 只是语音状态机恢复监听，并没有主动停止音乐。

修改内容：

- 删除首次 PCM 入队时的隐式启动。
- 等待正式的 `AUDIOIOC_START` 后再启动播放后端。
- 保留现有 512 KiB 音频环形缓冲和 DMA 配置，不增加内存。
- 修改位置：[board_voice_audio.c:374](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/board_voice_audio.c:374)、[board_voice_audio.c:1137](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/board_voice_audio.c:1137)、[board_voice_audio.c:1275](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/board_voice_audio.c:1275)

#!/bin/bash
# fix_gemini_s1.sh - Minimal audio-framework patch for ai_agent / mini_memo
#                    on the Gemini-s1 board (Allwinner R528, r528s3-gemini-s1)
#
# Usage:
#   cd <project-root>   # e.g. contest-2026/
#   bash packages/ai_agent/fix_gemini_s1.sh
#   ./build.sh vendor/allwinnertech/boards/r528/r528s3-gemini-s1/configs/nsh_minidisplay/ \
#       -e -Wno-error -j$(nproc)
#
# Unlike fix_esp32s3.sh this script does NOT need to run in the background:
# it can run once before the build. It does two things:
#
#   1. Rewrites the board's media graph.conf / criteria.txt with a minimal
#      capture + playback pipeline (see below).
#   2. Applies mini_memo_ptt_record_fix.patch - the cross-repo C fixes for the
#      "recording receives no frames / PTT hangs" root cause (DMA IRQ teardown,
#      media server accept pump, ffmpeg abufsink format negotiation).
#
# Why the graph patch exists
# --------------------------
# The stock Gemini-s1 media graph wires up the full smart-speaker pipeline
# (Ring/Music/Alarm movie sources, Video0/Video1, A2DP sink, a 10-input amix,
# VOIP/WWE/MDS capture sinks, voice-change, ...). ai_agent / mini_memo only
# needs a plain microphone capture path and a plain PCM playback path. Running
# the full graph on this board pulls in services the demo does not use and
# makes the record / playback path harder to bring up.
#
# It replaces the board's graph.conf and criteria.txt with a minimal pair that
# exposes exactly two routes through the media server:
#
#   * capture : adevsrc(/dev/audio/pcm0c) -> abufsink@acap
#   * playback: abufsrc@apb            -> adevsink(/dev/audio/pcm0p)
#
# Both run at 48 kHz / stereo, which matches what the ai_agent audio capture
# and playback code requests from the media framework on this board. Nothing
# outside the audio framework is touched.
#
# The graph changes cannot be expressed in defconfig because graph.conf /
# criteria.txt are plain resource files, not Kconfig options.

set -euo pipefail

# Resolve project root (parent of packages/)
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

MEDIA_DIR="$ROOT_DIR/vendor/allwinnertech/boards/r528/r528s3-gemini-s1/src/etc/media"
GRAPH="$MEDIA_DIR/graph.conf"
CRITERIA="$MEDIA_DIR/criteria.txt"

if [ ! -d "$MEDIA_DIR" ]; then
    echo "[fix] ERROR: media config dir not found: $MEDIA_DIR"
    echo "[fix]        Is this the Gemini-s1 (r528s3-gemini-s1) source tree?"
    exit 1
fi

echo "[fix] Applying minimal audio-framework graph for ai_agent / mini_memo..."

# ---- Fix 1: minimal media graph --------------------------------
# Two independent routes: mic capture -> abufsink, abufsrc -> speaker.
if [ -f "$GRAPH" ] && [ ! -f "$GRAPH.ai_agent.bak" ]; then
    cp "$GRAPH" "$GRAPH.ai_agent.bak"
fi
cat > "$GRAPH" <<'EOF'
adevsrc@pcm0c=format=nuttx:sample_rate=48000:ch_layout=stereo:devname=/dev/audio/pcm0c:map=1,volume@VolAcap=precision=fixed[acap0],
[acap0]abufsink@acap;

abufsrc@apb=map=1,volume@VolApb=precision=fixed[apb0],
[apb0]adevsink@pcm0p=format=nuttx:sample_rate=48000:ch_layout=stereo:devname=/dev/audio/pcm0p
EOF
echo "  [1/2] graph.conf: minimal capture + playback routes written"

# ---- Fix 2: matching policy criteria ---------------------------
# Point Capture/Ring/Music/Alarm at the minimal abufsink/abufsrc nodes so the
# policy engine can resolve them against the new graph.
if [ -f "$CRITERIA" ] && [ ! -f "$CRITERIA.ai_agent.bak" ]; then
    cp "$CRITERIA" "$CRITERIA.ai_agent.bak"
fi
cat > "$CRITERIA" <<'EOF'
InclusiveCriterion UsingDevices     : mic a2dpsnk = mic
InclusiveCriterion ActiveStreams    : acap VOIPtx WWEtx MDStx
ExclusiveCriterion Capture          : abufsink@acap
ExclusiveCriterion Ring             : abufsrc@apb
ExclusiveCriterion Music            : abufsrc@apb
ExclusiveCriterion Alarm            : abufsrc@apb
ExclusiveCriterion Video Video0     : movie_async@Video0
ExclusiveCriterion VtunVideo Video1 : movie_async@Video1
ExclusiveCriterion TalkCap          : amoviesink_async@acap
ExclusiveCriterion VoipCap          : amoviesink_async@VOIPtx
ExclusiveCriterion WWEtx            : amoviesink_async@WWEtx
ExclusiveCriterion MDStx            : amoviesink_async@MDStx
NumericalCriterion persist.media.AcapGain AcapGain : [1,10] = 10
NumericalCriterion persist.media.AlarmVolume AlarmVolume : [0,20] = 10
NumericalCriterion persist.media.A2dpsnkVolume A2dpsnkVolume RingVolume MusicVolume MediaVolume : [0,20] = 10
ExclusiveCriterion VoiceChangeMode  : normal dashu xiaochou = normal
EOF
echo "  [2/2] criteria.txt: minimal policy criteria written"

echo "[fix] Media graph done. Original files saved as *.ai_agent.bak in:"
echo "      $MEDIA_DIR"

# ---- Fix 3: cross-repo PTT recording fixes ---------------------
# Apply mini_memo_ptt_record_fix.patch. It bundles three independent repo
# diffs, separated by "===== REPO: <path> =====" markers. We split it and
# git-apply each segment in the matching repo. Each apply is idempotent: if a
# segment already reverse-applies (i.e. is already present), it is skipped.
PATCH_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/defconfigs/gemini-s1/mini_memo_ptt_record_fix.patch"

apply_repo_segment() {
    # $1 = repo path (relative to ROOT_DIR), $2 = segment file
    local repo="$ROOT_DIR/$1"
    local seg="$2"

    if [ ! -s "$seg" ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ ! -d "$repo/.git" ] && [ ! -f "$repo/.git" ]; then
        echo "  [skip] $1: not a git repo, cannot apply"
        return 0
    fi

    if git -C "$repo" apply --reverse --check "$seg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  [skip] $1: already applied"
        return 0
    fi
    if ! git -C "$repo" apply --check "$seg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  [WARN] $1: patch does not apply cleanly, skipping."
        echo "         Apply manually: git -C $1 apply <segment>"
        return 0
    fi
    git -C "$repo" apply "$seg"
    echo "  [ok]   $1: PTT recording fix applied"
}

if [ -f "$PATCH_FILE" ]; then
    echo "[fix] Applying mini_memo_ptt_record_fix.patch..."
    TMPDIR_PTT="$(mktemp -d)"
    trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR_PTT"' EXIT

    # Split the bundle into per-repo segments by the REPO marker.
    awk -v out="$TMPDIR_PTT" '
        /^===== REPO: / {
            repo = $3
            gsub(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/, "_", repo)
            seg = out "/" repo ".patch"
            next
        }
        seg { print > seg }
    ' "$PATCH_FILE"

    apply_repo_segment "vendor/allwinnertech"        "$TMPDIR_PTT/vendor_allwinnertech.patch"
    apply_repo_segment "frameworks/multimedia/media" "$TMPDIR_PTT/frameworks_multimedia_media.patch"
    apply_repo_segment "external/ffmpeg/ffmpeg"      "$TMPDIR_PTT/external_ffmpeg_ffmpeg.patch"

    echo "[fix] PTT recording fix done."
else
    echo "[fix] NOTE: $PATCH_FILE not found, skipping PTT recording fix."
fi

echo "[fix] All done."
refresh_demo_kconfig
bootstrap_hal_checkout
prepare_build_context
# build.sh context runs savedefconfig and may omit explicit "not set"
# entries; re-apply the contest network policy before validating .config.
python3 "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/scripts/build_voice.py" \
  --openvela "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" --prepare-only

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files

#include <media_defs.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
#define EXTERN extern "C"

#define EXTERN extern

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Functions
 ****************************************************************************/

/**
 * @brief Open a player path with given stream type.
 *
 * @param[in] stream    MEDIA_STREAM_*.
 *                      Different stream types have different route logic.
 * @return void*    Player handle, NULL on failure.
 *
 * @code To simply play a song you should:
 *  // 1. create a instance.
 *  handle = media_player_open(MEDIA_STREAM_MUSIC);
 *
 *  // 2. prepare the resource you want to play.
 *  ret = media_player_prepare(handle, "/data/1.mp3", NULL);
 *
 *  // 3. start playing.
 *  ret = media_player_start(handle);
 *
 *  // 4. stop playing and clear the prepared song,
 *  //  should goto step2 if you still need this player instance.
 *  ret = media_player_stop(handle);
 *
 *  // 5. don't forget to destroy the instance.
 *  ret = media_player_close(handle, 0);
 * @endcode
 */
void* media_player_open(const char* stream);

/**
 * @brief Close the player path.
 *
 * @param[in] handle        Player handle.
 * @param[in] pending_stop  Whether pending stop before close:
 *                          - 0: stop immediately for closing;
 *                          - 1: stop till complete current playing track.
 *                          Besides, This parameter is only applicable to audio player.
 *                          Setting this parameter to 1 for video player does not have
 *                          the pending_stop function.
 * @return int  Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 */
int media_player_close(void* handle, int pending_stop);

/**
 * @brief Set a event callback to listen to stream status change.
 *
 * @param[in] handle        Player handle.
 * @param[in] event_cookie  Callback argument.
 * @param[out] on_event     Callback to receive events about stream status change.
 * @return int  Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 *
 * @code
 *  void user_on_event(void* cookie, int event, int result, const char* extra) {
 *      switch () {
 *      case MEDIA_EVENT_PREPARED:
 *      case MEDIA_EVENT_STARTED:
 *      case MEDIA_EVENT_PAUSED:
 *      case MEDIA_EVENT_STOPPED:
 *      case MEDIA_EVENT_SEEKED:
 *      case MEDIA_EVENT_COMPLETED:
 *      }
 *  }
 * @endcode
 */
int media_player_set_event_callback(void* handle, void* event_cookie,
    media_event_callback on_event);

/**
 * @brief Prepare resource to play.
 *
 * @param[in] handle    Player handle.
 * @param[in] url       Path of resource, there is 2 mode:
 *                      1. URL: `url` is Local file path or Network address;
 *                          media framework would read the resource and play.
 *                      2. BUFFER: `url` is NULL, so caller should continuously
 *                          provide buffers to media framework for playing;
 *                          there are 2 ways to provide buffers,
 *                              1. Use `media_player_write_data()`.
 *                              2. Use `media_player_get_socket()` and `write()`
 * @param[in] options   Extra options about the resource, usually it's key-value pairs
 *                      to describe format of resource.
 *                      (e.g. "format=s16le,sample_rate=44100,channels=2")
 * @return int  Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 *
 * @note The api mentioned for buffer mode are all thread-safe.
 */
int media_player_prepare(void* handle, const char* url, const char* options);

/**
 * @brief Reset media with player type.
 * @param[in] handle The player path, return value of media_player_open
 * function.
 * @return Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 */

/**
 * @brief Reset the player path.
 *
 * @param[in] handle    Player handle.
 * @return int  Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 *
 * @note This api is similar to `media_player_stop`.
 */
int media_player_reset(void* handle);

/**
 * @brief Write data to media for playing.
 *
 * @param[in] handle    Player handle.
 * @param[in] data      Buffer address.
 * @param[in] len       Buffer length to write.
 * @return ssize_t  Sent length on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 *
 * @note This api is thread-safe, in buffer mode, you might need this
 * in your worker thread.
 */
ssize_t media_player_write_data(void* handle, const void* data, size_t len);

/**
 * @brief Get socket address info for buffer mode.
 *
 * @param[in] handle    Player handle
 * @param[out] addr     Socket address info
 * @return int  Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 */
int media_player_get_sockaddr(void* handle, struct sockaddr_storage* addr);

/**
 * @brief Get socket fd for writing.
 *
 * @param[in] handle    Player handle.
 * @return int  Socket fd, negative errno on failure.
 *
 * @note This api is thread-safe, in buffer mode, you can get socket fd
 * for data transaction in your worker thread.
 */
int media_player_get_socket(void* handle);

/**
 * @brief Close socket fd.
 *
 * @param[in] handle    Player handle.
 *
 * @note This api is thread-safe, in buffer mode, you can finalize data
 * transaction by this api in your worker thread.
 */
void media_player_close_socket(void* handle);

/**
 * @brief Start/resume playing the resource.
 *
 * @param[in] handle    Player handle.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Apply or reverse the contest-local FFmpeg amix helper build backport.

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
readonly FFMPEG_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/external/ffmpeg/ffmpeg"
readonly PATCH_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../patches/0025-ffmpeg-asubgraph-amix-helper.patch"
readonly PATCHED_FILE="libavfilter/Makefile"

die()
{
  echo "FFmpeg amix backport: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

require_repository()
{
  test -f "${PATCH_FILE}" || die "patch not found: ${PATCH_FILE}"
  git -C "${FFMPEG_DIR}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    die "FFmpeg checkout not found: ${FFMPEG_DIR}"
}

require_clean_target()
{
  git -C "${FFMPEG_DIR}" diff --quiet -- "${PATCHED_FILE}" ||
    die "refusing to overwrite existing FFmpeg change: ${PATCHED_FILE}"
}

patch_is_applied()
{
  git -C "${FFMPEG_DIR}" apply --reverse --check "${PATCH_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

apply_patch()
{
  require_repository

  if patch_is_applied; then
    echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
    return 0
  fi

  require_clean_target
  git -C "${FFMPEG_DIR}" apply --check "${PATCH_FILE}" ||
    die "backport does not apply cleanly"
  git -C "${FFMPEG_DIR}" apply --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
  echo "APPLIED"
}

reverse_patch()
{
  require_repository

  if patch_is_applied; then
    git -C "${FFMPEG_DIR}" apply --reverse --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
    echo "REVERTED"
  else
    require_clean_target
    echo "NOT_APPLIED"
  fi
}

case "${1:-}" in
  apply)
    apply_patch
    ;;
  reverse)
    reverse_patch
    ;;
  status)
    require_repository
    if patch_is_applied; then
      echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
    else
      require_clean_target
      git -C "${FFMPEG_DIR}" apply --check "${PATCH_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
        die "backport does not apply cleanly"
      echo "READY"
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Usage: $0 {apply|reverse|status}" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# Apply or reverse the contest-local completed-state Media player backport.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
+readonly MEDIA_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/frameworks/multimedia/media"
+readonly PATCH_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../patches/0027-media-player-completed-stop.patch"
+readonly PATCHED_FILE="server/media_player.c"
+
+die()
+{
+  echo "Media completed-state backport: $*" >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+require_repository()
+{
+  test -f "${PATCH_FILE}" || die "patch not found: ${PATCH_FILE}"
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
+    die "Media checkout not found: ${MEDIA_DIR}"
+}
+
+patch_is_applied()
+{
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --reverse --check "${PATCH_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1
+}
+
+apply_patch()
+{
+  require_repository
+  if patch_is_applied; then
+    echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
+    return 0
+  fi
+
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" diff --quiet -- "${PATCHED_FILE}" ||
+    die "refusing to overwrite existing Media change: ${PATCHED_FILE}"
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --check "${PATCH_FILE}" ||
+    die "backport does not apply cleanly"
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
+  echo "APPLIED"
+}
+
+reverse_patch()
+{
+  require_repository
+  if patch_is_applied; then
+    git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --reverse --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
+    echo "REVERTED"
+  else
+    echo "NOT_APPLIED"
+  fi
+}
+
+case "${1:-}" in
+  apply) apply_patch ;;
+  reverse) reverse_patch ;;
+  status)
+    require_repository
+    if patch_is_applied; then echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"; else echo "READY"; fi
+    ;;
+  *) echo "Usage: $0 {apply|reverse|status}" >&2; exit 2 ;;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# Apply or reverse the contest-local completed-state Media player backport.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
+readonly MEDIA_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/frameworks/multimedia/media"
+readonly PATCH_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../patches/0027-media-player-completed-stop.patch"
+readonly PATCHED_FILE="server/media_player.c"
+
+die()
+{
+  echo "Media completed-state backport: $*" >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+require_repository()
+{
+  test -f "${PATCH_FILE}" || die "patch not found: ${PATCH_FILE}"
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
+    die "Media checkout not found: ${MEDIA_DIR}"
+}
+
+patch_is_applied()
+{
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --reverse --check "${PATCH_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1
+}
+
+apply_patch()
+{
+  require_repository
+  if patch_is_applied; then
+    echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
+    return 0
+  fi
+
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" diff --quiet -- "${PATCHED_FILE}" ||
+    die "refusing to overwrite existing Media change: ${PATCHED_FILE}"
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --check "${PATCH_FILE}" ||
+    die "backport does not apply cleanly"
+  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
+  echo "APPLIED"
+}
+
+reverse_patch()
+{
+  require_repository
+  if patch_is_applied; then
+    git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --reverse --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
+    echo "REVERTED"
+  else
+    echo "NOT_APPLIED"
+  fi
+}
+
+case "${1:-}" in
+  apply) apply_patch ;;
+  reverse) reverse_patch ;;
+  status)
+    require_repository
+    if patch_is_applied; then echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"; else echo "READY"; fi
+    ;;
+  *) echo "Usage: $0 {apply|reverse|status}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+esac

已修复并完成构建。

问题根因是：

- 歌曲达到 EOF 后，`tool_media.c` 又调用了一次 `media_player_stop()`。
- Media 音频图已经处于 EOF 状态，重复 `unlink` 触发：
  `Assertion !li->status_in failed`
- `mediad` 随后退出，已入队的 PCM 没有机会继续送入 I2S，所以日志出现 `dequeued_pcm=0`，最终没有声音。
- 当前日志中的 `WLAN-RX nobuf=0`，说明这次不是 WLAN 丢包导致。

已修改：

- [tool_media.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent/src/tools/tool_media.c:292)：自然播放完成时只记录 `COMPLETED`，保留媒体句柄，不再立即重复停止。
- [0027-media-player-completed-stop.patch](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/patches/0027-media-player-completed-stop.patch:1)：Media 已完成状态下清理时跳过第二次 `audio_graph_stop()`。
- [build_with_hal_backport.sh](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/scripts/build_with_hal_backport.sh:858)：构建时自动应用补丁，结束后自动恢复上游工作区。
- 新增补丁管理脚本：[media_player_completed_backport.sh](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/scripts/media_player_completed_backport.sh:1)。

验证结果：

- `build_with_hal_backport.sh -j8`：成功

请烧录这个 `nuttx.bin` 后测试同一首歌。预期不再出现 `status_in` 断言，歌曲结束时应看到 `COMPLETED/EOF`，并且 `MEDIA-BRIDGE` 的 PCM dequeue 数量应大于零。当前尚未进行真实板卡烧录和扬声器验证。
请整理下面对这个音乐播放问题，你都用了什么方法解决

针对这次“歌曲无声音并触发 Media 断言”的问题，我采用了以下方法：

1. **根据日志定位直接故障链**

   日志显示：

   ```text
   cmd: stop
   audio_graph unlink
   Assertion !li->status_in failed
   playback close drain=0
   dequeued_pcm=0
   ```

   这说明歌曲已经进入 EOF 状态后，又被重复执行了 `stop`。音频图中的 FFmpeg link 已经标记为 EOF，第二次 `unlink` 触发断言，`mediad` 退出，剩余 PCM 没有机会送入 I2S，因此没有声音。

2. **排除 WLAN 作为本次直接原因**

   同一段日志中：

   ```text
   [WLAN-RX] ... nobuf=0
   ```

   说明这次没有 WLAN RX 缓冲丢包。TTS 网络也完成了请求，因此本次主要问题在 Media 播放生命周期，而不是 Wi-Fi 或 TCP。

3. **修改 Agent 的媒体状态处理**

   在 [tool_media.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent/src/tools/tool_media.c:292) 中：

   - 增加 `MEDIA_STATE_COMPLETED` 状态。
   - 收到 `MEDIA_EVENT_COMPLETED` 时只记录播放完成状态。
   - 不再立即调用 `force_close_locked()`。
   - 保留媒体句柄，允许音频输出完成剩余 PCM。
   - 下一次播放、显式停止或清理时再关闭句柄。

   这样避免了“自然结束事件”和“主动 STOP”重复操作同一个音频图。

4. **增加 Media 服务端的完成状态保护**

   新增 contest 本地补丁：

   [0027-media-player-completed-stop.patch](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/patches/0027-media-player-completed-stop.patch:1)

   当 Media 服务端状态已经是 `MEDIA_PLAYER_STATE_COMPLETED` 时，清理流程跳过第二次 `audio_graph_stop()`，但仍然释放队列、解码器和音频图资源，保证显式停止和下一次播放仍然可用。

5. **把上游修改限制在 contest 工程中**

   新增：

   [media_player_completed_backport.sh](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/scripts/media_player_completed_backport.sh:1)

   并接入：

   [build_with_hal_backport.sh](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/scripts/build_with_hal_backport.sh:858)

   构建开始时自动应用补丁，构建结束时自动撤销补丁。因此最终提交只需要保留 `contest2026_295_suanliheidong` 内的文件，不需要直接修改外部 Media 仓库。

6. **执行完整构建和静态验证**

   - 完整 `build_with_hal_backport.sh -j8`

text:
有明显差别。当前 `contest2026_295_suanliheidong` 已经不是 `contest_inital` 的简单复制，而是把音乐播放从“应用层自解码”迁移成了“OpenVela Media 原生播放”。

| 对比项 | `contest_inital` | 当前 `contest2026_295_suanliheidong` |
|---|---|---|
| 播放后端 | `robot_media_player.c` 自己建立 HTTP 下载线程 | `robot_music_media.c` 调用 `media_player_open/prepare/start` |
| MP3 解码 | Webclient + Helix MP3，应用层手动解码 | Media/FFmpeg 负责解码、重采样和 EOF |
| 音频格式 | 应用层手动降为 24 kHz 单声道，并做音量缩放 | 通过 `graph.conf` 的 `aresample` 转为 24 kHz 单声道 |
| Media 服务 | 不依赖 `mediad` 也可以工作 | 依赖 `CONFIG_MEDIA`、`mediad`、Media IPC 和 `/etc/media/graph.conf` |
| URL 处理 | 主要支持 HTTP MP3，并对网易云 URL 做转换 | 原生支持 Media 的 URL、重定向和 FFmpeg 输入流程 |
| 播放控制 | 自己维护 worker、stop、completed 状态 | 使用官方 Media 的 pause/resume/seek/status/event 接口 |
| PCM 输出 | 直接写入 `robot_audio_playback` | Media 输出到 `/dev/audio/pcm0p`，再经板级 bridge 写入 I2S DMA |
| EOF 处理 | 自己调用 `robot_audio_playback_finish()` 后关闭 | 需要同步 Media EOF、APB、DMA 和音频图生命周期 |
| 连续语音集成 | 主要是独立音乐播放 | 与 TFLite 唤醒、连续 ASR、流式 TTS、语音抢占共用 I2S |

旧工程的核心实现位于 [robot_media_player.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest_inital/app/robot_voice/robot_media_player.c:1)。它的路径大致是：

```text
网易云 HTTP
  -> webclient
  -> Helix MP3 解码
  -> 手动降采样/混音/音量处理
  -> robot_audio_playback_write()
  -> I2S DMA
```

当前工程使用 [robot_music_media.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_music_media.c:1)，路径变成：

```text
HTTPS/HTTP URL
  -> mediad
  -> FFmpeg demux/decode
  -> Media graph
  -> /dev/audio/pcm0p
  -> board_voice_audio.c
  -> robot_audio_playback
  -> I2S DMA
```

新功能带来的主要变化有：

1. **格式支持更完整**

   当前实现不再局限于应用层 Helix MP3，可以使用 FFmpeg/Media 的输入、重定向、解码和重采样能力。代价是播放依赖更多组件，`mediad` 没有启动、IPC 不可用、DNS/TLS 失败或 graph 配置异常，都会直接影响播放。

2. **启动流程变复杂**

   当前代码增加了 Media 服务探测和懒启动逻辑，会先尝试复用已有 `mediad`，服务不可用时才执行 `mediad &`。这是为了避免重复启动两个 Media 服务，但也比旧工程多了 IPC 服务就绪、启动超时和服务状态判断。

3. **PCM 和 DMA 的所有权变复杂**

   当前 [board_voice_audio.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/board_voice_audio.c:1) 不会在 PCM 刚复制到环形缓冲后立即把 APB 当成已播放，而是结合 DMA 进度、队列和 FINAL 标记管理 APB 归还。

   同时，`robot_audio_playback.c` 增加了：

   - 原生 Media 播放模式；
   - 4/8/16 DMA slot 动态协商；
   - Media 专用 512 KiB PCM ring；
   - DMA 完成进度统计；
   - 网络输入空洞和短尾处理；
   - Media pause/resume/EOF 接口。

   当前 DMA 最大数量仍然是 16，但实际可能因为内部 DRAM 只分配到 4 个或 8 个 slot。这样比固定使用 16 个 slot 更适合当前内存限制，但启动缓冲和抗网络抖动能力会随实际 slot 数变化。

4. **连续语音功能增加了资源竞争**

   当前 `robot_voice_main.c` 从约 1600 行扩展到约 5500 行，加入了：

   - TFLite 唤醒词；
   - 连续录音和 ASR worker；
   - Flash/LLM 流式处理；
   - 句子级 TTS 预取；
   - 网络重试；
   - 音乐和 TTS 的 I2S 所有权协调；
   - 对话中断和新指令优先级处理。

   这些功能改善了连续对话能力，但也增加了线程、栈、堆、网络缓冲和锁竞争，因此比 `contest_inital` 更容易暴露 I2S DMA、内存和 Media 生命周期问题。

5. **当前工程增加了 Media EOF 修复**

   旧工程的自解码线程在完成播放后自己收尾，不会经过 Media 服务端的 EOF 状态机。

   当前工程使用官方 Media 事件后，曾出现：

   ```text
   MEDIA_EVENT_COMPLETED
   -> 再次 media_player_stop()
   -> audio_graph_stop()
   -> FFmpeg status_in 断言
   ```

   因此当前增加了：

   - `tool_media.c` 的 `MEDIA_STATE_COMPLETED`；
   - 完成事件不立即重复 stop；
   - Media 已完成状态下跳过第二次 `audio_graph_stop()` 的 contest 补丁。

   这是当前工程相较于 `contest_inital` 新增的必要兼容逻辑。

6. **构建依赖不同**

   旧工程在 `CONFIG_MEDIA` 关闭时编译 `robot_media_player.c`；当前工程固定编译 `robot_music_media.c`，并通过 CMake hook 把官方 `tool_media.c` 重定向到 contest 的 native Media 接口，相关配置在 [CMakeLists.txt](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/CMakeLists.txt:30)。

因此，当前工程的音乐播放能力更完整，也能与连续语音、TTS 和官方 Media 框架统一，但它对 `mediad`、FFmpeg、Media graph、APB 生命周期和 DMA 状态的依赖更多。之前出现的“只响一下”“没有声音”“`status_in` 断言”，都属于这条新播放链路中的状态同步问题，而不是旧工程那种单纯的 HTTP/Helix 播放路径。

`graph.conf` 的目标格式在两个工程中基本一致，主要差别集中在解码后端、Media 服务依赖、PCM bridge 和播放生命周期管理。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Apply or reverse the contest-local completed-state Media player backport.

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
readonly MEDIA_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/frameworks/multimedia/media"
readonly PATCH_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../patches/0027-media-player-completed-stop.patch"
readonly PATCHED_FILE="server/media_player.c"

die()
{
  echo "Media completed-state backport: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

require_repository()
{
  test -f "${PATCH_FILE}" || die "patch not found: ${PATCH_FILE}"
  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    die "Media checkout not found: ${MEDIA_DIR}"
}

patch_is_applied()
{
  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --reverse --check "${PATCH_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

apply_patch()
{
  require_repository
  if patch_is_applied; then
    echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
    return 0
  fi

  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" diff --quiet -- "${PATCHED_FILE}" ||
    die "refusing to overwrite existing Media change: ${PATCHED_FILE}"
  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --check "${PATCH_FILE}" ||
    die "backport does not apply cleanly"
  git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
  echo "APPLIED"
}

reverse_patch()
{
  require_repository
  if patch_is_applied; then
    git -C "${MEDIA_DIR}" apply --reverse --whitespace=nowarn "${PATCH_FILE}"
    echo "REVERTED"
  else
    echo "NOT_APPLIED"
  fi
}

case "${1:-}" in
  apply) apply_patch ;;
  reverse) reverse_patch ;;
  status)
    require_repository
    if patch_is_applied; then echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"; else echo "READY"; fi
    ;;
  *) echo "Usage: $0 {apply|reverse|status}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

### 新 `/dev/audio/pcm0p` 做什么

它现在不再是：

```text
pcm0p
→ audio_i2s
→ contest_i2s
```

而变成：

```text
pcm0p
→ F7D bridge
→ robot_audio_playback
```

bridge 实现了 Media/NuttX 需要的：

```text
GETCAPS
CONFIGURE
GETBUFFERINFO
RESERVE
START
ENQUEUEBUFFER
STOP
FLUSH
RELEASE
```

其中真正的数据路径只有：

```c
robot_audio_playback_write(&apb->samp[apb->curbyte], len);
```

而 `robot_audio_playback_write()` 会先把 PCM 拷进自己的 256 KiB ring，所以写调用返回后，Media 可以安全复用自己的 APB。现有实现确实是 producer 写 ring、独立 worker 消费。fileciteturn32file0L1265-L1345

我已经做了 **F7F**：

这版 wrapper 会自动：

- 临时把 contest-local `defconfig` 作为 build context 的权威配置；

- 编译结束后再检查 `libavcodec/codec_list.c` 必须包含 `ff_pcm_s16le_encoder`；
- 如果 encoder 仍不存在，直接让构建失败，避免再烧录一个必然 `adevsink -22` 的固件。

这和源码链路是对应上的：NuttX output muxer 默认 audio codec 就是 `PCM_S16LE`，然后 `nuttx_write_header()` 才会进入 `ff_nuttx_open()`。fileciteturn35file0L335-L351 `ff_nuttx_open()` 真正第一步设备配置才是 `AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE`。fileciteturn35file1L580-L609 所以你现在始终看不到 `AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE`，非常符合 encoder 阶段提前失败。


```bash
grep -F "CONFIG_LIB_FFMPEG_CONFIGURATION=" nuttx/.config

grep -F "ff_pcm_s16le_encoder" \
  external/ffmpeg/ffmpeg/libavcodec/codec_list.c
```

两个都必须命中。

然后再测：

```text
mediad &
mediatool
open Music
prepare 0 url /etc/media/test.wav
start 0
```

```text

```

```text

[C-I2S-DIAG] ...
```

也就是说，一旦 F7F 能越过 `adevsink -22`，后面的 PCM 就会进入你已经验证过的 `robot_audio_playback_write()` 链路，而不是再维护一套 Media→I2S 硬件路径。

第一，**启动顺序问题已经稳定复现**：

```text
boot → mediad & → ai_agent → set_wifi
                         ↓
                      联网失败
```

但：

```text
boot → ai_agent → set_wifi 成功

                         ↓
                      网络继续正常
```

所以目前可以先把它当作一个明确的初始化顺序约束：**Wi-Fi 必须先完成初始化，再启动 mediad。** 这不是公网问题，因为网络一旦先建立起来，mediad 和 Agent 可以共存。长远应该在 contest 层把 mediad 做成“network ready 后再启动”，但现在先不要混进音乐播放排查。

第二，也是现在更重要的：**F6 的播放器已经不再死在 `media_player_open()`。**

你的日志已经走到了：

```text
media_player_open
→ 成功建立 player
→ player thread 存在
→ prepare
→ media_player_open_demuxer
→ avformat_open_input(...)
→ ret -5
```

然后才：

```text
Prepare failed
→ stop
→ close
```

这证明：

```text
PFW Music 映射 ✓
Media RPC ✓
media_player_open ✓
player thread ✓
进入 FFmpeg demux ✓
```

失败点现在是：

> **FFmpeg 无法打开这个网易云 HTTPS 音频 URL。**

`-5` 对应典型的 I/O error。FFmpeg 的 HTTP 层在底层连接、HTTP 错误、重定向异常等情况下都可能最终返回 I/O error；尤其 HTTP 301/302/307/308 重定向路径本身也是 FFmpeg HTTP protocol 的一部分。citeturn693041search0

所以现在**完全不要改 `pcm0p` / contest_i2s**。还没走到那里。

### 下一步我建议做 F6.2：本地文件播放烟雾测试

这是目前信息量最高的一刀。

目标不是“听歌”，而是回答：

```text
FFmpeg Player 本身到底能不能从本地文件
一路走到 Audio Graph / pcm0p？
```

你当前 board ROMFS 只放了 `graph.conf / criteria.txt / settings.pfw`，没有测试音频。fileciteturn14file0L21-L30

因此让 Codex 在 **contest 目录内**加入一个很小的本地测试 WAV，比如：

```text
/etc/media/test.wav
```

建议：

```text
PCM WAV
24000 Hz
mono
1~2 秒
```

然后直接绕过网易云搜索，使用官方 Media Player/mediatool 对：

```text
file:///etc/media/test.wav
```

或该版本官方 API 实际要求的本地文件 URL/path 做播放测试。

判断会非常干净：

- 如果本地 WAV 也在 `avformat_open_input()` 失败：问题在 FFmpeg file/demux 配置。
- 如果本地 WAV 能 `prepare` 成功，但随后 adevsink / Audio 报错：终于进入 `/dev/audio/pcm0p`，下一步查 Audio lower-half。
- 如果看到 `[C-I2S]` 并出现 `immutable reject bytes=...`：就是我们之前已经预判的 **2048-byte APB 限制**。你的 TX 现在硬性要求每个提交恰好 2048 bytes，否则直接 `-EINVAL`。fileciteturn11file0L158-L170
- 如果看到 data width 被设置成 16-bit，也会失败，因为当前 speaker TX 只接受 32-bit。fileciteturn11file0L125-L137

### 网易云这一条先不要修

当前 URL：

```text
https://music.163.com/song/media/outer/url?id=....mp3
```

很可能还涉及：

```text
HTTP redirect
→ 新 host
→ HTTPS/TLS
→ Range/seek
→ CDN response
```

而官方 FFmpeg Player 现在只给我们一个：

```text
avformat_open_input ret -5
```

信息太少。

先用本地 WAV 把：

```text
Media Player
→ FFmpeg demux
→ Audio Graph
→ adevsink
→ /dev/audio/pcm0p
→ audio_i2s
→ contest_i2s
```

这条链验证通，效率最高。

另外，**F6 的 `domain: Empty` 建议暂时保留**。因为现在它同时实现了：

```text
PFW enabled
→ Music criterion 可用
→ Media Player 能 open
```

而又避免了原来：

```text
domain: MusicDomain
conf: default
ALL
```

导致的 Agent 网络异常。你的原配置确实就是这个简单的 domain/default/ALL。fileciteturn14file0L10-L12

所以现在我建议暂时固定一个开发基线：

```text
单核
Wi-Fi 先初始化
settings.pfw = domain: Empty
然后启动 mediad
```

接下来只做 **F6.2 本地 WAV**。这一步如果成功，我们就可以正式告别 PFW/网络这部分，开始最后的 Audio/I2S 兼容修复。"}

### 现在最大的冲突：Media 是 s16，但你的 I2S TX 固定 32-bit

官方 `audio_i2s_configure()` 会把上层给出的：

```text
channels
bits-per-sample
sample rate
```

直接传给 I2S lower-half 的：

```c
I2S_TXCHANNELS()
I2S_TXDATAWIDTH()
I2S_TXSAMPLERATE()
```

当前官方代码就是这样。citeturn442922view0

Media 现在明确请求：

```text
mono
24000 Hz
16-bit PCM
```

你的 TX：

- mono：支持；
- 24000 Hz：支持；
- **16 bit：不支持。**

你的代码明确要求：

```c
if (bits != CONTEST_I2S_TX_WIDTH)
```

而 `CONTEST_I2S_TX_WIDTH` 是 32。fileciteturn11file0L125-L137

fileciteturn17file0L27-L31

readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"

readonly NUTTX_BREAK_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_break_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_WLAN_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/esp32s3_wlan_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_raw_exception_backport.sh"

readonly MYENV_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/myenv"
readonly BUILD_SH="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/build.sh"

# These are user-owned source trees.  build.sh context is allowed to prepare

readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS="${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS:-packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/packages/ai_agent contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src}"
readonly LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/openvela-local-source-${BASHPID}"

cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}"

snapshot_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local found=0

  mkdir -p "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}"
  : > "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  for rel in ${LOCAL_SOURCE_PATHS}; do
    if test ! -d "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}"; then
      echo "Local source snapshot: skip missing ${rel}" >&2
      continue
    fi

    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    # Snapshot user-owned source/config only.  Never preserve generated
    # objects/archives, otherwise restore_local_sources() can resurrect stale
    # code after a context/clean operation.
    tar -C "${OPENVELA_ROOT}" \
      --exclude=.git \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      -cpf "${archive}" "${rel}"
    printf '%s\n' "${rel}" >> "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"
    found=1
  done

  if test "${found}" != 1; then
    echo "No local source roots were found; refusing to build without source protection." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Local source snapshot created; context may not replace local source files."
}

restore_local_sources()
{
  local rel
  local archive
  local restore_root="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/restore"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"
  mkdir -p "${restore_root}"

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    archive="${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/${rel//\//__}.tar"
    tar -C "${restore_root}" -xpf "${archive}"
    rsync -a --delete \
      --exclude='.git' \
      --exclude='*.o' \
      --exclude='*.a' \
      --exclude='*.d' \
      --exclude='*.gcno' \
      --exclude='*.gcda' \
      --exclude='*.pyc' \
      --exclude='__pycache__/' \
      "${restore_root}/${rel}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/${rel}/"
  done < "${LOCAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT}/paths"

  rm -rf "${restore_root}"

  echo "Local source snapshot restored; compiling the files present before context."
}

apply_contest_ai_agent_overlay()
{
  if test ! -d "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}"; then
    echo "Missing contest-local ai_agent overlay: ${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # The generated build context still resolves the package from
  # packages/ai_agent.  Synchronize the complete contest-local package there,
  # including deletions, while leaving the nested Git metadata and generated
  # build artifacts alone. restore_local_sources() restores the original
  # checkout at EXIT.
  ai_agent_overlay_applied=1

    --exclude='*.o' \
    --exclude='*.a' \
    --exclude='*.d' \
    --exclude='*.gcno' \
    --exclude='*.gcda' \
    --exclude='*.pyc' \

    "${AI_AGENT_OVERLAY_DIR}/" "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/"

  echo "Complete contest-local ai_agent source tree applied; build uses the contest copy."
}

cleanup_local_source_snapshot()

}

hal_tree_ready()
{
  local tree="$1"
  local submodule
  local status_line

  test -n "${HAL_EXPECTED_VERSION}" || return 1
  test -d "${tree}" || return 1
  git -C "${tree}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  test "$(git -C "${tree}" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" = "${HAL_EXPECTED_VERSION}" || return 1

  for submodule in "${HAL_REQUIRED_SUBMODULES[@]}"; do

    if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]][0-9a-f]{40}[[:space:]]' <<<"${status_line}"; then
      return 1
    fi
  done
}

hal_checkout_ready()
{

hal_cache_ready()
{
  hal_tree_ready "${HAL_CACHE_DIR}"

restore_hal_from_cache()
{

    rm -rf "${HAL_DIR}"
  fi
